newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mixed, S&Ps near flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mixed, S&Ps near flat.

text.p: May 1 - U.S. stock index futures ended mixed. S&Ps slashed losses, closed little-changed. Brokers said late action was mainly position-flattening before Friday's April US jobs data. Nonfarm payrolls seen rising 211,000, 5.2-pct jobless rate, 0.3-pct rise in hourly earnings, 34.7-hr workweek. Some said S&Ps ability to recoup from losses boded for more gains soon. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
But nearby S&Ps managed to stop eroding above Wednesday's low at 795.25 and subsequently nearly erased losses in late trading that had thinned from a brisk morning pace.
Price boards showed volume in June S&Ps of about 83,000.

"You need to go back. I think the idea was that we'd rally a little bit today and then sell off before the numbers, and we probably got ahead of ourselves," said a third broker of the final bout of loss-cutting.
Some chartists said the contract's ability to recover and close nearly flat could bode for more gains soon, although they said an overbought condition could make buyers leery.

Traders saw arbitrage sell programs at the open and during the late-morning break when the premium shrank and before the Dow 30 Industrial average fell 50 points and triggered New York Stock Exchange's curb on computer-assisted index arb.
Futures barely reacted when the April national purchasing manager's index slipped to 54.2 versus forecasts for 53.6. The prices component fell to 49.6, but employment rose to 52.8.

June S&P 500s lost 0.75 pt to 802.05, Midcaps rose 2.15 to 259.50, Russell rose 4.35 to 349.25, Nasdaq rose 9.65 to 889.00, Nikkei 225 fell 130.0 to 19,310.0. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
